title: A new color token used in a font view must be set by every preview surface
rule: The font views (list, grid, waterfall) can carry a `.surface-light` or `.surface-dark` class that replaces `--fm-bg` with the opposite theme's background. Any theme token you use for text or chrome inside those views (`--fm-success`, `--fm-danger`, a new one) must also be set in both surface classes in `styles/theme.css`, or it keeps the app theme's value on the swapped background. Add a Playwright check that sets a dark app with the Light surface and a light app with the Dark surface and computes the contrast ratio from the computed colors.
rationale: E15.1 (#118): the green 'Open license' badge used --fm-success, which the surface classes did not override, so it fell to about 1.7:1 (dark app, Light surface) and 2.7:1 (light app, Dark surface).
